# mapping_set_description: SSSOM mapping_set bridging Q-031 delta-eta-star universal UniversalGrantTypeScheme + SubmissionChannelScheme to UK&W localGrantTypes 5 values + Scotland Confirmation 3 values + Switzerland Erbschein + EU SR 650/2012 European Certificate of Succession Article 67 + T60 JurisdictionalSubmission primitive subclass mappings. Authored Sunday 18 May 2026 BST.

column5: object_label
UK&W grant_of_probate (Senior Courts Act 1981 Part VI; testate; named executor proves the will)
Scotland confirmation with executor_nominate (Confirmation of Executors Scotland 1858; will-derived executor authority)
Switzerland Erbschein for testate cases (ZGB Art 559 + cantonal procedure)
UK&W letters_of_administration_with_will_annexed (will exists but executor renounces / predeceases / unable)
Scotland confirmation with executor_dative for testate cases (Sheriff Court appoints administrator; bond of caution required)
UK&W letters_of_administration (no will; AEA 1925 s.9 Public Trustee pre-grant vesting)
Scotland confirmation with executor_dative for intestate cases (Succession Scotland 1964)
Switzerland Erbschein for intestate cases (ZGB Art 457-466 three-parentele rules)
UK&W limited_grant (limited in scope — specific assets / foreign property excluded / temporary administration)
UK&W de_bonis_non (grant for unadministered estate when original executor dies)
Scotland eik_confirmation (Scots-specific supplementary confirmation when assets discovered post-confirmation)
Scotland small_estate_certificate (≤£36,000 simplified procedure; conceptually adjacent though strictly different category per Spice 2025)
EU SR 650/2012 Article 67 European Certificate of Succession issued (Member State competent authority; Art 4 habitual-residence jurisdiction)
EU SR 650/2012 Article 67 ECS for intestate succession
T60 JurisdictionalSubmission#ApiSubmission subclass (OAuth + idempotency-key + machine ack; HMRC MTD VAT pattern; no current probate-grant API exists)
T60 JurisdictionalSubmission#PortalUploadSubmission subclass (portal-URL + login-state + PDF payload; UK&W MyHMCTS mandatory post-2 Nov 2020)
T60 JurisdictionalSubmission#EmailAttachmentSubmission subclass (email-route + attachment-set + delivery-evidence; Swiss cantonal Erbschein typical)
T60 JurisdictionalSubmission#PaperSubmission subclass (post / in-person submission; UK&W PA1P/PA1A citizen route + Scotland Form C1)
UK&W MyHMCTS portal mandatory for solicitor grant applications since 2 Nov 2020 (digital statement of truth)
Scotland Form C1 inventory paper submission to Sheriff Court (no portal yet)
Switzerland cantonal authority email submission (varies by canton; ZH Bezirksgericht / SG Notariat / etc.)
EU SR 650/2012 Article 62 ECS automatic recognition across Member States (issued in one MS recognised in all per P-10 Berenbrok b-fold distinction issued-vs-recognised)
